assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome, requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk.
This diagnostic procedure is medically necessary to address the documented clinical indications.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the authorization was absent, the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
You have the right to appeal this determination.
Please submit a formal appeal request along with any supporting clinical documentation within the timeframe specified in your member handbook.
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the forfeiture of appeal rights.
